overview.summary: Two independent thin documentation slices produce the two required note artifacts, each with the exact minimal content shape defined by the PRD.

stories.name: Primary note artifact
stories.scope: Deliver the first required note artifact with exactly one heading and one bullet. The slice includes only that artifact and its prescribed content shape; it excludes the second note artifact and all planning or specification artifacts.

stories.name: Secondary note artifact
stories.scope: Deliver the second required note artifact with exactly one heading and one bullet. The slice includes only that artifact and its prescribed content shape; it excludes the first note artifact and all planning or specification artifacts.
